name: MagicGEO for WooCommerce
author: magicgeo

sections.description:
MagicGEO for WooCommerce helps store owners analyze and optimize their product content for AI-powered search engines such as Google SGE, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.

What is GEO?

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of structuring product content so that AI-powered search engines can accurately understand, index, and cite it.

Features

  • Analyze WooCommerce products against GEO criteria (title length, description quality, images, SKU, categories, pricing).
  • Generate Schema.org Product markup automatically on product pages.
  • One-click AI optimization via the MagicGEO API.
  • GEO score tracking per product with status indicators.
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible.
  • Internationalization ready with included translation files.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A MagicGEO API key (obtain one at magic-geo.tech)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the magicgeo folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to MagicGEO > Settings and enter your API key.
  4. Go to the MagicGEO dashboard to analyze and optimize your products.
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API key?

Create an account at magic-geo.tech to obtain your API key.

Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. MagicGEO for WooCommerce requires WooCommerce 8.0 or later to be installed and active.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares full compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Does this work with all themes?

Yes. MagicGEO operates in the WordPress admin and injects Schema.org markup in the page head. It does not modify theme templates.
